summary: Adult male sleeping in Rio Grande Park, Aspen was bitten on the head ~3 a.m. by a black bear; he escaped his sleeping bag and called for help; transported by ambulance to a hospital, treated for head and facial injuries and released; an adult female bear matching the description was euthanized.
notes: CPW 8/19/2026 release (dual incident release); victim unhoused; carcass to CPW Wildlife Health Lab.
